objective.summary: Make legacy impact_surface classification project-configurable while preserving built-in defaults and avoiding CR or registry mutation.

feature_context.reason: Legacy impact classification, impact-report, and CR brief behavior.
Focused tests for configurable classification rules.

acceptance: Optional process/project/IMPACT-SURFACE-RULES.yaml extends classification for legacy impact_surface values.
Built-in high-confidence rules remain active and generic module-path fallback runs after project rules.
Supported match types include prefix, exact, contains, suffix, and regex.
Rule target_field values must be one of the existing impact split fields.
impact-report and CR brief both use the configurable classification path.
No CR files or canonical registries are auto-mutated by classification rules.
verification_plan: uv run pytest tests/test_cr_lifecycle.py tests/test_feature_registry.py tests/test_cr037_project_current.py tests/test_cr037_project_scale_roadmap.py tests/test_state_v2.py tests/test_cp_result_event_ledger.py tests/test_story_evidence.py
uv run meta-flow state check --project-root . --mode enforce
uv run meta-flow event check --ledger process/state/CHECKPOINT-LEDGER.ndjson --type checkpoint
